name: Reverse Desire ~Uragaeru Yokubou~
source:
The hero of the story is Murayama Shuuji. A football elite of the Soccer Club and the best player on the team. With his perfect career and image, he is the future of the prestigious Mitakadai School. Many girls admire him for his talent.

Among the admirers is Miyamori Toone, the student council president. Hozumi Yuina, his quiet childhood friend. And the sweet and kind kouhai, Natsuki Mana. Surrounded by beautiful girls, all who love him so much.

It's a perfect life of a boy and a group of girls who admire him...But there is a ghastly figure staring from among the shadows...

His name is Tatsukawa Takeshi, the hero of the "dark side" of the story. The unpopular physical education teacher, in fact hated by the school. As he sees Shuuji with his growing popularity, makes him burn with envy as his fame grows out of control.

He detests Shuuji's popularity. And with dark ambition, he wants to turn the school into a sea of despair...

So, who will they prey? Which will they devour? Will you lead them into the road of serenity? Do you make them cry and scream? Will you bring hope for those who care the most? Or will you turn everything inside out into a twisted fate?

It is all up to you which way the wheel turns......
translation:
故事的主人公是村山修二。足球俱乐部的足球精英，也是球队中最好的球员。凭借完美的事业和形象，他是久负盛名的三鹰台学校的未来。许多女孩都钦佩他的才华。

学生会长宫森东根就是其中之一。Hozumi Yuina，他安静的儿时朋友。还有可爱又善良的后海夏希真奈。周围都是美丽的女孩，都是如此爱他的人。

这是一个男孩和一群仰慕他的女孩的完美生活……但阴影中却有一个可怕的身影……

他的名字叫龙川武，是故事中“黑暗面”的主人公。这位不受欢迎的体育老师，实际上是被学校所讨厌的。当他看到修二的人气越来越高时，他的名声越来越不受控制，他嫉妒得要命。

他讨厌修二的受欢迎程度。并且怀着黑暗的野心，他要将学校变成一片绝望的海洋……

那么，他们会捕食谁呢？他们会吞噬哪一个？你会带领他们走上平静之路吗？你会让他们哭泣和尖叫吗？你会给最关心的人带来希望吗？或者你会把一切都彻底扭转成扭曲的命运吗？

车轮向哪个方向转动完全取决于你……
